## Coaching Note

You had Black's bishop undefended on b7. When the opponent attacks a square, look for checks that expose loose pieces on your next move. Here, **Qxd7+** forces the king to move, which abandons d7's defense of the bishop. After **Kf8**, you simply capture it with **Qxb7**. Even Black's counterattack **Qxg2+** fails because you recapture and keep your material advantage. Always calculate forcing moves before quiet moves—checks often win material you'd miss otherwise.
